name: 30132 · Dallas, GA
findings: ZIP 30132 (Dallas) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30132 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30132 (Dallas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
